Degree Programs, Advisor Information, and Application Instructions
Certificate
Specialized training in an area of study
Enhances knowledge and skills in a specialized field for career advancement and professional development. Can serve as a springboard to further graduate study.
Time commitment: often less than one year
Master's
Comprehensive study of a specific field
Offers broad, foundational knowledge of a specific field or discipline, often concluding with a capstone project or thesis. Can lead to a variety of career paths or to doctoral study.
Time commitment: two years on average
Doctoral
Advanced, specialized study of a field
Provides deep, specialized knowledge and skills, often through fieldwork and original research. Can lead to careers in academia, industry, nonprofits, government, and beyond.
Time commitment: 5-7 years on average
In addition to a Master’s or Doctoral program, students may choose to pursue a Transcripted Minor if approved by their major and minor units.
